Build core strength and stability with this 20 min yoga flow. In this dynamic core yoga practice, we’ll explore how your diaphragm and deep core work together so you can move with more control through challenging poses and transitions.
I’ll guide you through a strong sequence and show you how to coordinate your breath with movement. As the practice builds, see if you can keep your breath steady while your core does more work.
Join me in the Transform Course
